DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_DEFENSE.title: Dongni Defense
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_DEFENSE.description:
At the start of your turn, gain {DongniDefensePower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
You can no longer gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards.
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_STRIKE.title: Dongni Strike
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card in your deck.
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_CURSE.title: Dongni's Curse
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_CURSE.description: While this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], your card draw and [gold]Energy[/gold] gain effects take effect next turn instead.
